response.title: Online grievance registration
response.description: The system shall allow an applicant to register a grievance online against an application, with category and description, and shall route it to the District Social Welfare Officer of the applicant's district within 24 hours.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a grievance registered against an application, when it is saved, then a grievance number is shown and it appears in the DSWO's grievance list.
response.rationale: The term 'quickly' is ambiguous and has been replaced with the measurable time limit of 24 hours to ensure precise routing.
